target: 國立體育大學/桃園校區/buildings/ntsu-arena
face_id_basis: Zero-based unchanged binary STL record order. Do not assume Blender/importer polygon indices match.

mapping_contract.signature_algorithm: Each vertex is exact little-endian float32 x,y,z. Canonical triangle signature is SHA256 of lexicographically smallest CYCLIC rotation of its 36 vertex bytes; reversal is not allowed. All 30648 signatures are unique.
mapping_contract.global_multiset_digest: SHA256 of sorted 64-character signature hex strings joined with LF and terminal LF.
mapping_contract.ordered_signature_digest: SHA256 of signatures in original face order joined with LF and terminal LF.
mapping_contract.ordered_vertex_stream_digest: SHA256 of concatenated exact 36-byte triangle vertex records in original STL face order, with original corner order.
mapping_contract.output_requirement: Preserve all 30648 face records, exact float32 corner coordinates, orientation, face order and corner order, not only the approved subset. Match signatures one-to-one after import and restore source order before export. Reject any unrecoverable coordinate/order change. Vertex table deduplication is acceptable only if the reconstructed ordered triangle coordinate stream remains exact.
mapping_contract.units: Millimeters. Identity mesh transform; no scaling, rotation, mirroring or translation. Display unit metadata does not authorize numerical changes.
mapping_contract.mutation_policy: No mesh rebuild, subdivision, clipping, repair, remeshing, new faces, removed faces, smoothing-driven displacement, or face-index guessing. Original STL remains byte-identical.

palette_policy: Use these four fixed representative sRGB8 colors only; convert to linear shader inputs when required. No texture, image, UV painting, procedural mask, gradient, alpha/transmission or extra material. Any face expansion or palette change requires new source review.

main_dome.predicate: All 3 vertex z >= 37.9-epsilon and at least 1 vertex z > 37.9+epsilon. Includes existing cap/engraving surfaces; excludes horizontal lip and all vertical fascia.

horizontal_roof_rim_lip.predicate: All 3 vertex abs(z-37.9) < epsilon. Exactly 384 original triangles, connected around 192-edge boundary; no underside/vertical fascia included.

observed_front_glazing.predicate: Every vertex radial distance sqrt(x*x+y*y) within epsilon of 60.8, z in [10-epsilon,33.7+epsilon], and y <= epsilon. Existing raised horizontal bands and V supports excluded.

orientation_basis: Existing five modeled entrances are placed by angles -48,-24,0,24,48 around negative Y; four raised glazing bands are confined to y<=0. This agrees with official main entrance/front-plaza photos and original front preview/camera (-70,-260,120). Positive Y is deliberately unverified rear, not a second arbitrary front. y=0 is an evidence-scope boundary, NOT a claimed physical material seam.
hold_regions: All 208 rear cylinder glazing faces remain neutral: no sufficiently clear independent rear close view.
All 872 z=10 podium-top faces remain neutral: red floor/white parapet material boundary not built.

Vertical fascia/ring beam, V supports, raised front bands, entrances, underside surfaces and display base all remain neutral in this first bounded contract. Source suggests some structural white but this contract does not expand to them.

No arbitrary repair strips, octagon dark line, roof vents, tile ribs, mullions, blue entrance columns, lettering, banners, roads or landscape. Existing geometry remains but roof repair/weathering variations are deliberately not represented.
claim_limits: Limited material-family illustration on existing approximate geometry; not complete building coloration, surveyed reconstruction, historical exact condition or current-condition certification.
Main dome broad family only; vertical ring, underside, rear glass and all other surfaces remain neutral.
No added geometry, textures, photographic pixels or print certification.
